categories.main_business_segments: The company operates two primary business segments: (1) Motion Control Products - including motion controllers and motion control modules for electric vehicles and other applications, and (2) Power Chips - including MOSFET products (Trench-MOSFET, SGT-MOSFET, SJ-MOSFET) and related semiconductor devices. The company has established an integrated product chain from upstream power chip design to downstream motion control product applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs Fabless design model for power chips, utilizing advanced semiconductor design technologies including Trench-MOSFET, SGT-MOSFET, and SJ-MOSFET platforms. For motion control products, the company uses self-developed vector frequency conversion control schemes and multi-mode sensing/non-sensing control algorithms. Manufacturing includes self-production for motion control products and outsourced production (foundry and packaging) for power chips. The company has implemented automated production lines including full-automatic SMT, automatic soldering, and automatic testing equipment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are major electric vehicle manufacturers, particularly leading two and three-wheeled electric vehicle brands. The company also serves customers in electric tools, consumer electronics, and small household appliances sectors. The downstream market is primarily the electric vehicle industry, which represents over 90% of motion control product revenue. The company maintains direct relationships with large OEM manufacturers and also sells through distributors for power chip products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters and main manufacturing facilities in Zhangjiagang, Jiangsu Province. The company has established sales offices and on-site sales representatives in major sales regions. Revenue is primarily generated from domestic Chinese markets, with geographic segments including East China (56.91% of 2023 revenue), South China (19.57%), North China (17.50%), Southwest (5.86%), and Central China (0.18%).
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple supply chain positions: (1) Upstream - as a power chip design company (fabless model), (2) Midstream - as a motion control product manufacturer, and (3) Downstream integration - providing complete solutions to electric vehicle manufacturers. The company sources raw materials from suppliers, outsources semiconductor manufacturing and packaging, and directly manufactures motion control products for end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic priorities include: (1) Advancing motion control technology toward higher power and intelligent systems, (2) Expanding power chip product lines and improving self-supply ratios, (3) Developing new applications in electric vehicles, electric tools, and new energy sectors, (4) Implementing group-based management transformation and digital infrastructure upgrades, (5) Enhancing R&D capabilities in core technologies including SOC and TCS applications. The company invested 20.85 million yuan in R&D in 2023, representing 4.64% of revenue.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales of motion control products and power chips. Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of goods, typically upon delivery and customer confirmation. The company uses a direct sales model for motion control products to major OEM customers and a combination of direct sales and distributor channels for power chip products. The company also generates non-material revenue from other business activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the motion control sector, the company competes with other domestic manufacturers, with market position strengthened by relationships with leading electric vehicle brands. In the power chip sector, the company competes with international manufacturers (Infineon, ON Semiconductor) and domestic competitors. The company differentiates through its integrated upstream-downstream business model, specialized focus on motion control applications, and 'small but specialized' strategy in mid-to-low voltage MOSFET products. The company holds approximately stable market share in motion control products among leading electric vehicle manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized semiconductor and motion control manufacturer. 2023 revenue was 449.45 million yuan (down 16.31% from 537.06 million yuan in 2022), with net profit of 83.39 million yuan (down 21.39% from 106.08 million yuan in 2022). Total assets reached 1.70 billion yuan at year-end 2023 (up 115.24% from 788.72 million yuan in 2022), primarily due to IPO proceeds. The company went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in August 2023, raising 847.95 million yuan in net proceeds.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's key value propositions include: (1) Integrated upstream-downstream business model providing complete solutions from power chips to motion control systems, (2) Superior product quality and reliability critical for electric vehicle safety applications, (3) Rapid response capability to customer needs through dedicated sales teams and technical support, (4) Differentiated technology in vector frequency conversion and multi-mode control algorithms, (5) Cost advantages through optimized design and manufacturing processes, (6) Long-term partnerships with leading electric vehicle manufacturers based on proven product performance and supply reliability.
